primitives.summary: Single resume content contract: shape, safe links, PDF path, safe JSON keys and size limit, shared by Convex, the dashboard and the publication build.

guarantees.statement: content.upsertResumeDraft rejects contentJson that fails the contract with a ConvexError before any write.
guarantees.verifiedBy: apps/backend/convex/model/content/resume.ts#upsertResumeDraftHandler calls parseResumePageContent before ctx.db; private probe pr1-resume (aohys-primitives-20261013)

guarantees.statement: The dashboard editor and scripts/apply-dashboard-published-content.ts validate with the same contract; no other resume validator exists.

primitives.summary: One as-const array per domain vocabulary (locale, environment, release environment, lead intent/status/contact path, publication scope/request/attempt state, workflow outcome and provider status, media provider/usage/status, site setting key/classification, environment variable classification, writable media providers, case-study status/evidence); types derive from the arrays and Convex validators derive through literals().

guarantees.statement: Every exported validator in convex/lib/validators.ts wraps exactly the domain array mapped to it in VALIDATOR_VOCABULARIES (literals(<that array>)), and every inventoried vocabulary field of convex/schema.ts references its validator from ./lib/validators.js (only a Convex v.optional wrapper is unwrapped).
guarantees.verifiedBy: pnpm architecture:fitness (domain-vocabulary-derivation, SCHEMA_VOCABULARY_FIELDS in scripts/architecture/domain-vocabulary.mjs); probes with v.string(), a local v.literal and a non-Convex optional wrapper rejected; probes with a validator wired to the wrong array and an unmapped validator rejected

guarantees.statement: convex/schema.ts and convex/lib/validators.ts hold no string v.literal.
content.upsertSiteSetting accepts only keys in SITE_SETTING_KEYS (argument validator).

The publication build and preview seed scripts type their Convex payloads from the generated API (FunctionReturnType/FunctionArgs) instead of hand-written mirrors, and scripts/*.ts are typechecked by pnpm typecheck.
guarantees.verifiedBy: scripts/tsconfig.json in pnpm typecheck; a seeded type error in scripts/ is rejected

goals: Literal-copy detection outside the derived Convex files is a best-effort syntactic signal (unions, string arrays, v.union/v.literal lists; stale and drifted copies; per-statement // domain-vocabulary-ok exemption), not a proof that no copy exists; a copy it misses is fixed when found and, if it recurs, the consumer joins the symbol-derivation inventory.

Narrow siteSettings.key in convex/schema.ts to siteSettingKeyValidator and add it to SCHEMA_VOCABULARY_FIELDS once preview and production siteSettings rows are read and every stored key is in SITE_SETTING_KEYS (the argument validator already enforces it on writes).

primitives.summary: Single isRecord guard for untrusted values at runtime edges (provider responses, publication provider, site boundaries, release train, resume contract, build and observability scripts).

guarantees.statement: There is one isRecord definition; the eight former copies import @aohys/core/unknown-guards, and the module has no imports so plain Node .mjs scripts load it.

primitives.summary: Registry of every environment variable with provider, classification, exposure, required environments and targets, delivery destinations (convex-runtime, pages-runtime, release-job), GitHub value source and local example; validates environments and generates release artifacts.

guarantees.statement: The release workflow env blocks for preview and production and .env.example are generated from the contract; lint fails when either drifts.
The Convex env sync, the Cloudflare Pages runtime bindings and the Convex contact runtime values derive their variable lists from destinations.
guarantees.verifiedBy: scripts/sync-convex-env.ts, scripts/sync-cloudflare-pages-runtime.ts and apps/backend/convex/http.ts call the contract; rg finds no hand-written variable list in them

goals: Generate the README environment tables from the contract.

primitives.summary: Feature map of real, drivable journeys (read and write, allowed and denied) with launch, identity class, probes, cleanup, side-effect mode and private evidence, plus the contract checks and changed-file selection.

guarantees.statement: Every journey's sourceGlobs exist, write journeys declare a run-scoped cleanup, and a proven journey names its private run id, a proofRoute among its routes, an environment among its own environments (local or preview), its candidate commit and the hash of its contract; the proof goes stale when the contract, an entry point or any transitive dependency changes.
guarantees.verifiedBy: pnpm verify:product (validateFeatureMap with the architecture-fitness import graph)

guarantees.statement: verify:product:changed selects a journey when a changed file or any file that transitively imports it sits under its sourceGlobs.
The dashboard write surfaces (resume, projects, settings, publication), contact rejection and the denied-session refusal each have a journey.

goals: Prove the write and denied journeys on preview once an operator session and a denied account exist.

primitives.summary: The only public Convex builders: adminQuery, adminMutation and adminAction run requireAdmin against the Better Auth session and the single ADMIN_EMAIL allowlist before the handler, and expose the operator as ctx.admin.

guarantees.statement: Every Convex module is .ts; none imports a public builder (query, mutation, action, their Generic forms, or httpAction outside http.ts) except lib/functions.ts, whose builders keep the closed requireAdmin form; the TypeScript checker classifies every export of every module, nested and re-exported ones included, and each public function or HTTP action must be a const declared by an adminQuery/adminMutation/adminAction call, with any or unknown exports rejected; the modules are also evaluated as a Convex push would, and every export that is public at runtime must be one of those admin registrations.

The public HTTP surface is exactly POST and OPTIONS /contact plus one Better Auth route registration; the single router comes from convex/server's httpRouter and is used only through http.route with a literal path and method, registerRoutesLazy and the default export, and the evaluated router serves exactly the pinned route set.
ADMIN_EMAIL is parsed only by parseAdminAllowlist, used by the contract validator, the Pages dashboard gate and requireAdmin.
guarantees.verifiedBy: rg finds no other ADMIN_EMAIL parser in apps or packages

goals: Record admin, operator and system writes in auditEvents with the actor resolved by the builders.
